_comment: The Exposure Journal's report insights (core/exposure_report.py). Patterns in what she recorded, shown from MIN_DONE finished exposures with the values behind them. Partly done and skipped attempts are named neutrally. Never a cause, a diagnosis or advice. {placeholders} are filled in by the code.
locked: A few more exposures will show your patterns: {n} more done fully or in part.

insights.outcome_less: The feared outcome happened less often than you predicted: you expected about {predicted}%, and it happened in about {actual}% of exposures.
insights.outcome_same: The feared outcome happened about as often as you predicted (about {actual}%).
insights.outcome_more: The feared outcome happened more often than you predicted (about {actual}%, against {predicted}% expected). Noticing that is useful too.
insights.peak_lower: Your anxiety tended to peak lower than you predicted ({peak} against {predicted}), and to be at {end} by the end.
insights.peak_higher: Your anxiety tended to peak higher than you predicted ({peak} against {predicted}), and to be at {end} by the end. You stayed with it anyway.
insights.repeats: On steps you came back to, the peak tended to come down, from about {first} to {last}.
insights.safety: "{behaviour}" was the safety behaviour you most often planned to drop.
insights.partial: {partial} were done in part and {skipped} were set aside; each is part of the practice.

pattern: "{step}" has been tried {n} times over a few weeks without the prediction or the peak coming down.
empty_section: No exposure entries in this period
